commit_message:
feat(KernelDispatch): set inner-tile alignment hints on scalable unpack ops

Stacks on the scalable-pack hint support. Extend the alignment capture in
`MultiLoweringConfigGenerator::setNewTilingConfigs` to `linalg.unpack` ops:
after the loop tile sizes are scaled up into the unpacked (dest) domain by
`undoScaleAndPermutateTilingForUnpackOp`, each scalable inner tile is compared
against the (now scalable) loop tile on its dimension and the per-level result
is stashed as `iree_codegen.inner_tile_alignments`. This lets
`makeInnerTileAlignmentFn` read the unpack's alignment back instead of
recomputing it post-mortem. Distribution level excluded (see TODO).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

[Vulkan] Mark vkGetMemoryHostPointerPropertiesEXT as optional (#24737)

`vkGetMemoryHostPointerPropertiesEXT` only available if
`VK_EXT_external_memory_host` is available & enabled.
If the extension is not available and the function is marked as
required, `Vulkan device symbol 'vkGetMemoryHostPointerPropertiesEXT'
not found` is thrown, see #24717.

Call-sites are guarded by
`iree_hal_vulkan_allocator_supports_host_allocation_import`.

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@bd9990e127e1

Bumps the llvm-project submodule from llvm/llvm-project@d37fa5a838db to
llvm/llvm-project@bd9990e127e1, carrying one revert:
- llvm/llvm-project@202ece62657c ("[mlir][spirv] Add in-bounds access
chain conversion") emits spirv.InBoundsAccessChain for 16-bit sources
that get packed into 32-bit storage elements on targets without 16-bit
storage capabilities (e.g. storage=b32 Vulkan profiles), but the
MemRefToSPIRV bitwidth emulation patterns require a plain
spirv.AccessChain, failing to legalize memref.load/store of i16.

Adaptations needed:
- llvm/llvm-project@7e0416da49f4 removed `TargetOptions::FloatABIType`
in favor of the "float-abi" LLVM IR module flag. Store the float ABI on
IREE's `LLVMTarget` instead and stamp the module flag on generated
executables in the LLVMCPU target backend, preserving the previous
default (hard).
- Updated lit tests and the ROCM MLIR ukernel/specialization builtins
for MLIR assembly-format changes that moved inherent attributes out of
the attr-dict into declarative syntax.
- Regenerated CAPI export files for new MLIR C API symbols.

Assisted-by: Claude Code

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>
name: clang-tidy

commit_message:
[LLVMCPU][ukernel] Strip per-function target attributes to allow inlining

The ukernel bitcode carries per-function target-cpu/tune-cpu/target-features
attributes that conflict with the attribute-less dispatch (which inherits the
module-level TargetMachine)and stop LLVM from inlining the ukernel. Strip
them (and vscale_range, so RVV bitcode inlines) at link time.

Co-Authored-By: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
Co-Authored-By: Federico Bruzzone <federico.bruzzone.i@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Ege Beysel <beyselege@gmail.com>
name: clang-tidy

The ukernel bitcode carries per-function target-cpu/tune-cpu/target-features
attributes that conflict with the attribute-less dispatch (which inherits the
module-level TargetMachine)and stop LLVM from inlining the ukernel. Strip
them (and vscale_range, so RVV bitcode inlines) at link time.

Co-Authored-By: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
Co-Authored-By: Federico Bruzzone <federico.bruzzone.i@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Ege Beysel <beyselege@gmail.com>
name: Test TensorFlow / Linux (x86_64)

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@bd9990e127e1

Bumps the llvm-project submodule from llvm/llvm-project@d37fa5a838db to
llvm/llvm-project@bd9990e127e1. Clean fast-forward, no carry-over
reverts.

Adaptations needed:
- llvm/llvm-project@7e0416da49f4 removed `TargetOptions::FloatABIType`
in favor of the "float-abi" LLVM IR module flag. Store the float ABI on
IREE's `LLVMTarget` instead and stamp the module flag on generated
executables in the LLVMCPU target backend, preserving the previous
default (hard).
- Updated lit tests for MLIR assembly-format changes that moved
inherent attributes out of the attr-dict into declarative syntax.

Assisted-by: Claude Code

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>
name: setup / setup

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@bd9990e127e1

Bumps the llvm-project submodule from llvm/llvm-project@d37fa5a838db to
llvm/llvm-project@bd9990e127e1. Clean fast-forward, no carry-over
reverts.

Adaptations needed:
- llvm/llvm-project@7e0416da49f4 removed `TargetOptions::FloatABIType`
in favor of the "float-abi" LLVM IR module flag. Store the float ABI on
IREE's `LLVMTarget` instead and stamp the module flag on generated
executables in the LLVMCPU target backend, preserving the previous
default (hard).
- Updated lit tests for MLIR assembly-format changes that moved
inherent attributes out of the attr-dict into declarative syntax.

Assisted-by: Claude Code

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>
name: pre-commit

commit_message:
[Runtime][Build] Enable freestanding builds for IREE_PLATFORM_GENERIC (#24820)

Avoid assuming POSIX facilities are available on Generic platforms,
allowing the runtime to build for freestanding/bare-metal targets.

This disables POSIX-dependent functionality such as sockets and singal
handling by default, avoids selecting a POSIX async proactor, and
provides the small platform fallbacks needed by the Generic runtime
build.

This commit also adds Bazel support for the Generic riscv64
configuration, which is currently being brought up. It fixes additional
build-system issues encountered during Generic riscv bring up.

Assisted-by: Claude code

Signed-off-by: Pooja Hemashekar <hemashekar@roofline.ai>
name: setup / setup

commit_message:
[Vulkan] Mark vkGetMemoryHostPointerPropertiesEXT as optional (#24737)

`vkGetMemoryHostPointerPropertiesEXT` only available if
`VK_EXT_external_memory_host` is available & enabled.
If the extension is not available and the function is marked as
required, `Vulkan device symbol 'vkGetMemoryHostPointerPropertiesEXT'
not found` is thrown, see #24717.

Call-sites are guarded by
`iree_hal_vulkan_allocator_supports_host_allocation_import`.

Signed-off-by: Tobias Fuchs <fuchs@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
build: symbol renaming

This PR renames all mlir/llvm symbols to something else. That way we will never
have a symbol clash when loading a plugin that links to MLIR/LLVM already,
because they are named differently. We do this with llvm-objcopy and a
generated map file.

This also enables projects to use a black box backend potentially also
depending on another version of MLIR while we can use our backends safely in
the same process.

Signed-off-by: Jelle Schuhmacher <schuehmacher@roofline.ai>
name: setup / setup
